{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dolomar resistance''' was a collection of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] groups on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dolomar]] that opposed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rule of the planet. Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Dolomar resistance was responsible for overthrowing the local Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] and liberating the planet. [[Keleman Ciro]], and his brother, [[Noell Ciro|Noell]], were members of one of the groups before joining the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military.
